title: Altium Designer SDK sample
description: samples/<category>/<id>/sample.json, written by hand: what the sample is, its facets, search phrasings and commands. What its code uses (the SDK APIs) is derived by CI from the compiled code and published in index.json, never committed here.

schemaVersion.description: Incremented on any breaking change to this schema.

id.description: The sample's folder name, also its extension name.

title.description: One line: what the sample does.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what a developer learns from it.

domain.description: Where in Altium Designer it works.

surface.description: How it hooks into Altium Designer.

interactive.description: A command waits for the user in Altium Designer (a pick on the sheet or board, a dialog).

requiresRestart.description: Deploy it and restart Altium Designer before use: it adds a panel, menu, notification handler, outputer or document kind that Altium Designer loads at startup.

phrasings.description: How a user would ask for this task, for free-text search.

params.description: Key=Value parameters, separated by |, as passed to tools/ad.ps1 or the menu item.

readOnly.description: False when the command changes a document or Altium Designer state.
